title: Weil classes on abelian sixfolds of Weil type for $\mathbb{Q}(i)$ with discriminant $-3$
summary: Let $K=\mathbb{Q}(i)$. We prove that the Weil classes of every polarized complex abelian sixfold of Weil type for $K$ whose Hermitian discriminant is the non-split class $[-3]$ are algebraic, and that every Hodge class on every power of such a sixfold is algebraic when its Hodge group is the full special unitary group. The proof starts from Galois covers of the projective line with monodromy group $W(E_8)\cdot\mu_4$, branched over twelve points: the multiplicity space of the natural representation in the cohomology of such a cover is the first cohomology of an abelian sixfold of Weil type,…
